mapper.select: select *, (select count(*) from review r where r.attraction_id = #{no}) as reviewCnt from attractions where no = #{no};

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attractions (title, area_code, si_gun_gu_code, content_id, content_type_id, first_image1, first_image2, homepage, latitude, longitude, map_level, overview, tel) VALUES (#{title}, #{areaCode}, #{siGunGuCode}, #{contentId}, #{contentType.id}, #{firstImage1}, #{firstImage2}, #{homepage}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{mapLevel}, #{overview}, #{tel})
mapper.select: select no, title, first_image1 as thumbnail, (select count(*) from review r where r.attraction_id = attractions.no) as reviewCnt, overview, ST_Distance_Sphere( POINT(longitude, latitude), POINT(#{longitude}, #{latitude}) ) AS distance from attractions where ST_Distance_Sphere( POINT(longitude, latitude), POINT(#{longitude}, #{latitude}) ) <= 3000 ORDER BY reviewCnt DESC, distance asc LIMIT 10;
